sql:
select o.id as id, o.id as order_id, l.customer_id as customer_id, o.created_by as sales_user_id, 'auto' as status, `o`.`order_code`, pay.final_payment_date as completed_date, pay.paid_total as paid_total, COALESCE(c.name, '-') as customer_name, COALESCE(c.customer_status, '') as customer_status, `u`.`name` as `sales_name`, COALESCE(co.name, '-') as company_name, COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(pp.price,0) > 0
                    THEN COALESCE(pp.price,0) * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1)

                WHEN COALESCE(oi.vat_percent,0) > 0
                    THEN COALESCE(oi.line_total, (COALESCE(oi.unit_price,0) * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1)) - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)) / (1 + (COALESCE(oi.vat_percent,0) / 100))

                WHEN COALESCE(pc.vat_percent,0) > 0
                    THEN COALESCE(oi.line_total, (COALESCE(oi.unit_price,0) * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1)) - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)) / (1 + (COALESCE(pc.vat_percent,0) / 100))

                WHEN (
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(o.tax_amount,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(o.total_amount,0) > 0
                    THEN (COALESCE(o.total_amount,0) - COALESCE(o.tax_amount,0)) / COALESCE(o.total_amount,1)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) > 0
                    THEN COALESCE(oi.line_total, (COALESCE(oi.unit_price,0) * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1)) - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)) * (
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(o.tax_amount,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(o.total_amount,0) > 0
                    THEN (COALESCE(o.total_amount,0) - COALESCE(o.tax_amount,0)) / COALESCE(o.total_amount,1)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )

                ELSE COALESCE(oi.line_total, (COALESCE(oi.unit_price,0) * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1)) - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0))
            END
        ), 0) as total_amount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pc.barcode ORDER BY pc.barcode SEPARATOR ', ') as product_codes, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pc.name ORDER BY pc.name SEPARATOR ', ') as product_names, 
            CASE
                WHEN c.customer_status = 'lead'   THEN 0.5
                WHEN c.customer_status = 'member' THEN 1
                WHEN c.customer_status = 'retail' THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END
         as rate_percent, ((COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(pp.price,0) > 0
                    THEN COALESCE(pp.price,0) * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1)

                WHEN COALESCE(oi.vat_percent,0) > 0
                    THEN COALESCE(oi.line_total, (COALESCE(oi.unit_price,0) * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1)) - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)) / (1 + (COALESCE(oi.vat_percent,0) / 100))

                WHEN COALESCE(pc.vat_percent,0) > 0
                    THEN COALESCE(oi.line_total, (COALESCE(oi.unit_price,0) * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1)) - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)) / (1 + (COALESCE(pc.vat_percent,0) / 100))

                WHEN (
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(o.tax_amount,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(o.total_amount,0) > 0
                    THEN (COALESCE(o.total_amount,0) - COALESCE(o.tax_amount,0)) / COALESCE(o.total_amount,1)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) > 0
                    THEN COALESCE(oi.line_total, (COALESCE(oi.unit_price,0) * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1)) - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)) * (
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(o.tax_amount,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(o.total_amount,0) > 0
                    THEN (COALESCE(o.total_amount,0) - COALESCE(o.tax_amount,0)) / COALESCE(o.total_amount,1)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )

                ELSE COALESCE(oi.line_total, (COALESCE(oi.unit_price,0) * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1)) - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0))
            END
        ), 0)) * (
            CASE
                WHEN c.customer_status = 'lead'   THEN 0.5
                WHEN c.customer_status = 'member' THEN 1
                WHEN c.customer_status = 'retail' THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) / 100) as commission_calc from `crm_orders` as `o` inner join (select `p`.`order_id`, SUM(COALESCE(p.amount, 0)) as paid_total, MAX(COALESCE(p.payment_date, p.created_at)) as final_payment_date from `crm_payments` as `p` group by `p`.`order_id`) as `pay` on `pay`.`order_id` = `o`.`id` left join `crm_leads` as `l` on `l`.`id` = `o`.`lead_id` left join `crm_customers` as `c` on `c`.`id` = `l`.`customer_id` inner join `users` as `u` on `u`.`id` = `o`.`created_by` left join `companies` as `co` on `co`.`id` = `o`.`company_id` left join `crm_order_items` as `oi` on `oi`.`order_id` = `o`.`id` left join `crm_product_catalog` as `pc` on `pc`.`id` = `oi`.`product_id` left join (select `product_id`, `price_tier_id`, MAX(COALESCE(price, 0)) as price from `crm_product_prices` group by `product_id`, `price_tier_id`) as `pp` on `pp`.`product_id` = `oi`.`product_id` and `pp`.`price_tier_id` = `oi`.`price_tier_id` where `u`.`name` != ? and `pay`.`final_payment_date` is not null and COALESCE(pay.paid_total, 0) >= COALESCE(o.total_amount, 0) and exists (select 1 from `users` as `scu` where `scu`.`id` = `o`.`created_by` and (exists (select 1 from `departments` as `d` where `d`.`id` = `scu`.`department_id` and `d`.`name` in (?)) or exists (select 1 from `positions` as `p` where `p`.`id` = `scu`.`position_id` and `p`.`name` like ?) or exists (select 1 from `model_has_roles` as `mhr` inner join `roles` as `r` on `r`.`id` = `mhr`.`role_id` where `mhr`.`model_id` = `scu`.`id` and `mhr`.`model_type` = ? and `r`.`name` in (?, ?)))) and `pay`.`final_payment_date` between ? and ? and (`o`.`order_code` like ? or `c`.`name` like ? or `u`.`name` like ?) group by `o`.`id`, `l`.`customer_id`, `o`.`created_by`, `o`.`order_code`, `c`.`name`, `c`.`customer_status`, `u`.`name`, `co`.`name`, `pay`.`final_payment_date`, `pay`.`paid_total`
